name: robots/froststar16__bimanual-cooking-sim
title: Bimanual cooking kitchen (MuJoCo scene)
intro: Bimanual cooking kitchen (MuJoCo scene), adapted from froststar16/bimanual-cooking-sim. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
